items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Stan and I were just talking about that rib business.

ctx.x: I hadn't played in seven months. I stayed away from it to let the thing heal.
Stan and I were just talking about
that rib business. You didn't run any risk of pneumonia, then, Bud. You had to be pretty careful.
